correctness.rationale: After k live core vertices remain in K_n∘K_1, exactly k pendant edges of weight w and k(k-1)/2 core edges of weight one are available, hence p_k=2w/(k-1+2w). This gives the exact two-step generating-polynomial recurrence and n-K even. For fixed w>0, grouping adjacent visited levels and bounding double visits in L2 proves the compensator A_n=w log n+O_{L2,w}(1), quadratic variation Q_n=w log n+O_{L1,w}(1), and bounded martingale jumps give CLT and variance equivalent. In the positive weak-channel scaling w_n log n→c, the random hazard converges to c, maximal hazards and sum of squares vanish, the bounded exponential-martingale identity yields Poisson(c) nonforced pendant transitions, and deterministic final parity forces the stated fold. Boundary c=0 is correctly taken through positive weights; w=0 exactly is excluded. Finite full-state exact checks confirm recurrence, not asymptotic limit.
